description: Mirpurkhas Sugar Mills Limited is a sugar company of the Ghulam Faruque Group. It primarily manufactures food-grade refined white sugar, and states that it derives and uses molasses, bagasse and an organic mud from the process so that none of its by-products are wasted; the plant runs bagasse-fired boilers. The company added a Paper and Board Division in 2022, producing container board from recycled waste paper, virgin wood pulp and non-wood pulp at its Mirpurkhas site, and it is one of three partners in the UNICOL ethanol joint venture.
headOffice: Modern Motors House, Beaumont Road, Karachi 75530, Pakistan

products.name: Refined white sugar
products.summary: Food-grade refined white sugar, the company's primary product.

products.name: Molasses and bagasse
products.summary: By-products of sugar production; molasses is sold for ethanol production and bagasse is burned for power.

products.name: Paper and board
products.summary: Container board from recycled waste paper, virgin wood pulp and non-wood pulp, made by the Paper & Board Division set up in 2022 at Mirpurkhas, with a designed capacity of 250 metric tons of paper a day.

products.name: UNICOL Limited — ethanol
products.summary: A joint venture between Mirpurkhas Sugar Mills, Faran Sugar Mills and Mehran Sugar Mills; an ethanol plant at Mirpurkhas with a designed capacity of 200,000 litres a day, using molasses as feedstock.
